record.title: Connectivity Issues Affecting Some Users in Europe

updates.body:
Current status: The Slack engineering team investigated connectivity issues that affected some users between approximately 13:30 and 14:00 UTC on June 2, 2026. The issue has been resolved and no further impact has been reported.
Scope: Some users, primarily in Europe, may have experienced difficulty loading or sending Slack messages during this window
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.
